description: Ask ACI to list one offering of the company you act for. Returns a reference, a private listing token (shown once) and the domain-control challenge. ACI is a curated index: a request is reviewed and does not guarantee a listing. Nothing is published until the company approves an exact draft and ACI publishes it; payment never changes fit or order.

product_or_service.description: The one offering to list first.

target_customers.description: Who it is for and in which countries.

website.description: The company's own domain, e.g. example.com.
